mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST ( ROOM_KEY, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, CREATED_USER_KEY ) VALUES ( #{roomKey}, #{roomName}, #{roomType}, #{createdUserKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_KEY AS roomKey, ROOM_NAME AS roomName, ROOM_TYPE AS roomType, CREATED_USER_KEY AS createdUserKey, LAST_MESSAGE_KEY AS lastMessageKey, LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS lastMessageContent, LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, DELETED_YN AS deletedYn FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST WHERE ROOM_KEY = #{roomKey}

SELECT A.ROOM_KEY, A.ROOM_NAME, A.ROOM_TYPE, A.CREATED_USER_KEY, A.LAST_MESSAGE_KEY, A.LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT, A.LAST_MESSAGE_AT, A.CREATED_AT, A.UPDATED_AT, A.DELETED_YN FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST A INNER JOIN TB_CHAT_ROOM_USER B ON A.ROOM_KEY = B.ROOM_KEY WHERE B.USER_KEY = #{userKey} AND A.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND B.EXITED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY A.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC

SELECT A.ROOM_KEY AS roomKey, A.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, A.ROOM_TYPE AS roomType, A.LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS lastMessageContent, A.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, A.CREATED_AT AS createdAt,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_KEY = A.ROOM_KEY AND M.CREATED_AT > COALESCE( ( SELECT RM.CREATED_AT FROM TB_CHAT_MESSAGE RM WHERE RM.MESSAGE_KEY = B.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_KEY ), '1970-01-01' ) AND M.SENDER_USER_KEY != #{userKey} AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) AS unreadCount
FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST A INNER JOIN TB_CHAT_ROOM_USER B ON A.ROOM_KEY = B.ROOM_KEY
WHERE B.USER_KEY = #{userKey} AND A.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND B.EXITED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY COALESCE(A.LAST_MESSAGE_AT, A.CREATED_AT) DESC
